description:
Adds a value to the options of this custom field, for one customer or, without
`customer_id`, common to every customer. Use it to seed a catalogue before the first
invoice; values used on invoices are added on their own.

- **Equivalent values:** two values are equivalent when they match ignoring case, accents
  and repeated spaces. If the field already has an equivalent option — of that customer
  or a common one — no option is created: the response is `200` with the existing option,
  and its text is kept. Only when nothing equivalent exists is the option created, with
  `201`.
- **Archived options:** an equivalent archived option counts as existing. It comes back
  with `200` and stays archived; reactivate it with
  `PATCH /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options/{option_id}`.
- **Suggestions off:** a field with `suggest_values: false` accepts options in the same
  way, so a catalogue can be prepared before turning suggestions on. They are not
  offered on invoices while the setting is off.

BeeL API endpoint: POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/custom-fields/{key}/options (reference: https://docs.beel.es)

CreateCustomFieldOptionRequest.description: A value to add to the options of the field, for one customer or, without `customer_id`, common to every customer.

customer_id.description: Customer of the company the option belongs to. Omit it for an option common to every customer.

value.description: Text of the option. Leading and trailing spaces are removed; a value that is empty after that answers `422`. Two values are equivalent when they match ignoring case, accents and repeated spaces (`Gran  Via 12` and `gran vía 12`).

CustomFieldKey.description: Identifier of the custom field within the company, chosen when the field is created: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. It never changes. BeeL. gives it no meaning of its own.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company the operation acts on — its identifier, not its NIF. It is the only source of context: the account that owns it is derived from it, and the `BeeL-Active-Company` header plays no part. A company you do not reach answers `403`, and so does a company that does not exist, so the existence of a company in another account is never disclosed.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key for this operation. Omit it and one is derived from the request itself, which makes a blind retry safe but also collapses a SECOND, deliberately identical operation into the first for 24 hours. Set it — to an order id, or anything unique per intended operation — whenever you mean to create something that may look identical to what you just created.

key.description: Key of the custom field: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, up to 64 characters. A key outside that format answers `422`.

name: beel_create_custom_field_option
